description: This file defines an extension for 'OnboardingView' providing its layout and user interface logic, including navigation, page handling, and various view components related to onboarding.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout for OnboardingView, including a glowing icon, content pages, navigation bar, and related UI state handling.

methods.name: activePageIndex
methods.description: Calculates the current page index based on a given cursor, ensuring it stays within valid bounds.

methods.name: reconcilePageForModeChange
methods.description: Adjusts the current page with animation when the mode changes, aligning with the page order.

methods.name: navigationBar
methods.description: Constructs the navigation controls including back button, page indicators, and next button with appropriate state logic.

methods.name: onboardingPage
methods.description: Provides a scrollable view container for onboarding content, with styling and layout.

methods.name: onboardingCard
methods.description: Creates a styled container with padding, background, and shadow for onboarding components.

methods.name: onboardingGlassCard
methods.description: Creates a transparent styled card with overlay stroke for modern onboarding UI.

methods.name: featureRow
methods.description: Constructs a feature display row with icon, title, and subtitle.

methods.name: featureActionRow
methods.description: Constructs a feature row with an action button.

methods.name: featureRowContent
methods.description: Helper method to build the content inside feature rows, optionally including an action button.
